[EN] You are the dawn's horizon, ever sought by the sun. Or so it seems. You must overcome the trials of Balder's Temple to prove yourself worthy of the sun.

The first trial is to open the labyrinth's locked gate.

No key is required. Instead, you must prove your strength by defeating {@LinkCreature:425#1000$$Kakun}, the ruler of the outer gardens!
[ES] Eres el horizonte del alba, siempre buscado por el sol. O eso parece. Debes superar las pruebas del Balder's Temple para demostrar que eres digno del sol.

La primera prueba es abrir la puerta cerrada del laberinto.

No se requiere llave. En su lugar, debes demostrar tu fuerza derrotando a {@LinkCreature:425#1000$$Kakun}, ¡el gobernante de los jardines exteriores!

[EN] The sun itself shines on you and your victory.

Your next trial awaits. Find your way through the labyrinth and consult the {@Creature:425#3024#repository of wisdom} on the other side.
[ES] El sol mismo brilla sobre ti y tu victoria.

Tu siguiente prueba aguarda. Ábrete paso por el laberinto y consulta el {@Creature:425#3024#repositorio de sabiduría} al otro lado.
